oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: place_order performs a reserve operation followed by a charge without compensating on failure
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: multi-step operations must not leave partial state when a later step fails
mechanism_steps: no compensation step releases the reserved inventory
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_outcome: inventory remains reserved for an order that never completes
oracle_ground_truth.trap_description: the failure appears to be caused by charge_payment errors rather than missing rollback of the successful reservation

oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_source: place_order performs multiple side effects (reserve and audit) without compensating when payment fails
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_property: all side effects in a multi-step operation must be reversed if a later step fails
mechanism_steps: neither reservation nor audit entry is rolled back
oracle_ground_truth.mechanism_outcome: inventory and audit state persist for a failed order
oracle_ground_truth.trap_description: retrying the payment gateway appears to fix the failure but does not address the missing rollback of prior side effects

raw_stats is computed on the transformed data
the computation no longer reflects the original raw values
